fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. For In-country and Extension Students Passport main page (new and old passports), visa page (please ensure continuity) Proof of current enrollment Transcript for the current academic period Explanation of extension circumstances * 2. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. 3. For In-country Transfer Students Passport main page (new and old passports), visa page (please ensure continuity) Transfer certificate/No objection certificate Verification statement) Transcript from the previous school) Admission letter (in Chinese and English) * 4. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) * 5. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). * 6. Notarized highest degree transcripts, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. 1.Transcripts that are not in Chinese or English must be translated into Chinese and then notarized. 2.After notarization, they must also be authenticated by the local Chinese embassy or consulate (for countries that are part of the Hague Convention, an Apostille is required). 3.You must bring the original transcripts, as well as the original notarization and authentication documents, when reporting for registration. Otherwise, you will not be able to complete the registration. * 7. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 8. Notarized highest degree graduation certificate, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. For students from countries joined Hague Conventions could provide apostille documents. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English need to be translated into Chinese during notarization, and make sure you bring all original application documents including these to China during registration. * 9. Financial support statement Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature 10. Other materials If you are underage (over 17 years old, but not reach 18 when school starts), you should submit the Guardian letter which should be attested by the Chinese embassy in your country. 11. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . * 12. Students should sign a letter of undertaking * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Mathematics and Chemistry test results are required. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Age: 18 to 25. Students under 18 can also apply but they might need to find an adult(your family member, relatives or friends) living in China, better a Chinese, as your guarantor in China before you can apply, and your guarantor will need to provide related documents like guardian letter for you to support their applications. And you are more suggested to apply for this university after you were 18 years old. With an educational background equal to high school graduation in China And Band 3 certificate in HSK (Examination on Chinese language level) Note: Please be noted that when you enroll in the university, you should under 25 years old.
